note: Modeled deterministic consumption-contract vectors, in the ROS2 request/expect form. candidateEnvelope supplies an already evaluated envelope fixture, not an A/E computation formula. trustedFixtures represent independently established verification/status outcomes and do not claim cryptographic verification or real measurement. Every vector begins with all other required contracts satisfied. decision is a derived vector reading, never a new wire result enum. tighter outcomes are permitted for monotonic pairs; S33/S34 require at least regulated and no-looser ceilings, not a particular A/E value. Runtime implementations and real signature/current-state acquisition are external; vector/schema checks are prerequisites, never runtime certification.
timeNotation: All vector times/ages are fixed integer milliseconds, including proof and observation deadlines; wire-schema decision times are integer Unix seconds. No real clock, target effect or source measurement is represented.

schemaFixtureNote: Synthetic shape-only fixture. Digest strings and JWS segments are placeholders, not verified digests, a valid signature or an ordinary proof. It must never be used as authority. schemaVectors apply each isolated mutation to a fresh copy; omitted mutation means unchanged. Schema acceptance does not imply temporal, binding, token-representation or cryptographic acceptance.

rationale: Modeled shape fixture; not signed authority.
